# Semi Design System (@semi/ui v0.6.0)

> The shared UI of every Semi app: semantic tokens that work in light and dark mode, React components (Next.js, Tailwind CSS 4) and the rules agents follow. This Storybook shows each component live; this file is its text form.

Install `@semi/ui`, import components from `@semi/ui`, class constants from `@semi/ui/styles`, CSS `@semi/ui/tokens.css` + `@semi/ui/base.css`. Before writing UI read QUICK_REF.md; pick components from components.json; never invent local colours, sizes or wrapper components; check with `npx semi-lint`.

## Machine-readable

- [components.json](./components.json): all 80 components, hooks and constants with props and one-line summaries
- [QUICK_REF.md](./docs/QUICK_REF.md): Quick reference: the rules and imports to read before any UI change
- [DESIGN_SYSTEM.md](./docs/DESIGN_SYSTEM.md): Full design system rules (layout, colour, components, accessibility, anti-patterns)
- [ICONS.md](./docs/ICONS.md): Semantic icon guide: which icon means what
- [agent-rules.md](./docs/agent-rules.md): Rules block for a consumer app's AGENTS.md / CLAUDE.md
- [tokens.css](./docs/tokens.css): Generated design tokens (CSS variables for both themes)
- [llms-full.txt](./llms-full.txt): this file followed by all the docs above

## Pages

- [Foundations & Icons](./foundations.html): Surface tokens, the type scale and the searchable icon registry.
- [Components Showcase](./components.html): Theme switching, toolbars, buttons, form controls, KPI cards, chips, dialogs and skeletons.
- [Primitives & Forms](./primitives.html): Button, Field, choices, Tabs, Tooltip, Menu, Drawer, Toast, Alert, Progress, Table, EmptyState, locale.
- [Layout Patterns](./patterns.html): Page tabs and header actions, the tool-app header, SidePanel, Markdown and skeleton layouts.
- [AI Chat](./chat.html): The standard AI chat panel (AIChat), its parts and the provider / model / effort picker.

## Foundations & Icons (./foundations.html)

### Surfaces & tokens (./foundations.html#surfaces)

Every background, text and border colour: semantic tokens that switch with the theme, never palette classes.

```tsx
<div className="bg-canvas">            {/* app frame */}
  <main className="bg-app">           {/* content area */}
    <section className="bg-panel border border-line rounded-xl">   {/* card */}
      <h2 className="text-contrast">Title</h2>
      <p className="text-body">Body</p>
      <span className="text-muted">Caption</span>
      <input className="bg-field" />   {/* or FIELD_INPUT */}
    </section>
  </main>
</div>
// Status: bg-danger-bg border-danger-border text-danger-fg (success / warning / info), bg-*-solid for dots and bars
```

### Type scale (./foundations.html#typography)

All text sizes; font-medium / font-semibold only, sentence case, tabular-nums for numbers.

```tsx
text-caption 11 · text-label 12 · text-ui 13 (default UI) · text-ui-lg 14 · text-title 15 · text-title-lg 16
text-kpi 18 / sm:text-heading 22 (KpiCard) · text-heading 22 / sm:text-display 26 (PageTitle)
// no Tailwind text-xs / text-sm / text-base and no arbitrary pixel sizes
```

### Icon registry (./foundations.html#icons)

Every icon; pick by meaning from docs/ICONS.md (trash = delete, close = dismiss, refresh = sync).

```tsx
import { Icon, IconTile } from "@semi/ui";

<Icon name="refresh" className="w-4 h-4" />
<IconTile name="printer" tone="green" size="md" />
```

## Components Showcase (./components.html)

### Theme (light · dark · system) (./components.html#theme)

Theme setup of every app: applied before paint, stored, follows the OS on system.

```tsx
// app/layout.tsx
import { ThemeScript, ThemeProvider, ToastHost, ConfirmHost } from "@semi/ui";

<html lang="vi" suppressHydrationWarning>
  <head><ThemeScript /></head>
  <body className="bg-canvas text-body">
    <ThemeProvider>{children}<ToastHost /><ConfirmHost /></ThemeProvider>
  </body>
</html>

// settings / sidebar footer
<ThemeSwitcher fullWidth />   // or <ThemeToggle /> in a collapsed rail
```

### SubpageToolbar (./components.html#subpage-toolbar)

The sticky toolbar of a list page: filters left; add + search + refresh right.

```tsx
import { SubpageToolbar, Pills } from "@semi/ui";

<SubpageToolbar
  left={<Pills value={filter} onChange={setFilter} options={[{ key: "all", label: "Tất cả" }, { key: "printing", label: "Đang in" }]} />}
  onPrimaryAction={openCreate}
  primaryActionLabel="Thêm máy in"
  searchValue={q}
  onSearchChange={setQ}
  onRefresh={reload}
/>
```

### Buttons (./components.html#buttons)

Actions: one primary per area, secondary for the rest, danger for destructive, icon-only with aria-label.

```tsx
import { Button } from "@semi/ui";

<Button variant="primary" icon="play" onClick={start}>Bắt đầu in</Button>
<Button icon="edit">Sửa</Button>
<Button variant="danger" icon="trash">Xoá</Button>
<Button iconOnly icon="plus" aria-label="Thêm" />
<Button variant="primary" loading={saving}>Lưu</Button>
// class form: BTN_PRIMARY / BTN_SECONDARY / BTN_DANGER / BTN_GHOST (+ BTN_SM, BTN_ICON) from @semi/ui/styles
```

### Form controls (./components.html#form-controls)

Selects, comboboxes, numbers and dates: never the browser's own select, number or date inputs.

```tsx
import { Field, CustomSelect, CustomCombobox, NumberInput, DatePicker, Input } from "@semi/ui";

<Field label="Máy in"><CustomSelect variant="field" value={printer} onChange={setPrinter} options={printers} /></Field>
<Field label="Vật liệu"><CustomCombobox value={mat} onChange={setMat} options={materials} /></Field>
<Field label="Nhiệt độ"><NumberInput value={temp} onChange={(e) => setTemp(e.target.value)} unit="°C" integer /></Field>
<DatePicker value={date} onChange={setDate} ariaLabel="Ngày in" />
<Field label="Tên bản in" hint="Hiện trên thẻ"><Input value={name} onChange={(e) => setName(e.target.value)} /></Field>
```

### KPI cards & Pagination (./components.html#kpi)

Headline numbers of a dashboard (tabular-nums, shimmer while loading) and paged lists.

```tsx
import { KpiCard, Pagination } from "@semi/ui";

<KpiCard label="Tổng sản lượng" value="1.842" sub="+12.4% so với tuần trước" icon="box" tone="good" loading={loading} />
<Pagination page={page} pages={8} onChange={setPage} />
```

### Chips & badges (./components.html#chips)

Badge = read-only status / tag; Chip = on-off filter; Pills = single choice.

```tsx
import { Badge, Chip } from "@semi/ui";

<Badge tone="emerald" dot>Hoàn thành</Badge>
<Badge tone="amber" icon="clock">Đang xử lý</Badge>
<Chip active={on} onClick={() => setOn(!on)} tone="purple">Bambu Lab PLA</Chip>
```

### Modal & confirmDialog (./components.html#dialogs)

Dialogs (full screen on phones) and confirmations: never window.confirm / alert.

```tsx
import { Modal, Button, confirmDialog } from "@semi/ui";

<Modal open={open} onClose={close} title="Sửa máy in" footer={<Button size="modal" variant="primary" onClick={save}>Lưu</Button>}>
  …form…
</Modal>

if (await confirmDialog({ title: "Xoá máy in?", message: "Không thể hoàn tác.", confirmLabel: "Xoá", tone: "danger" })) remove();
```

### Skeletons (./components.html#skeletons)

Loading states: shimmer shapes of the real layout, never loading text or page spinners.

```tsx
import { Loading, SkeletonCard, SkeletonRows, SkeletonGrid } from "@semi/ui";

{loading ? <SkeletonGrid count={3} className="grid md:grid-cols-3 gap-3" /> : <Cards />}
<Loading><SkeletonRows count={5} /></Loading>   {/* Loading announces the region (role=status) */}
```

## Primitives & Forms (./primitives.html)

### Button & Spinner (./primitives.html#button)

The component form of the button classes; Spinner only inside the control running an action.

```tsx
import { Button, Spinner } from "@semi/ui";

<Button variant="primary" size="md" icon="check">Lưu</Button>
<Button size="sm" variant="ghost">Xem thêm</Button>
<Button size="modal" variant="secondary">Huỷ</Button>
<Spinner label="Đang lưu" />
```

### Field · Input · Textarea (./primitives.html#field)

Any labelled input: label, hint and error are wired for screen readers automatically.

```tsx
import { Field, Input, Textarea } from "@semi/ui";

<Field label="Tên máy in" hint="Hiện trên thẻ" error={errors.name} required>
  <Input icon="printer" value={name} onChange={(e) => setName(e.target.value)} />
</Field>
<Field label="Ghi chú"><Textarea rows={3} value={note} onChange={(e) => setNote(e.target.value)} /></Field>
```

### Checkbox · Switch · RadioGroup (./primitives.html#choice)

Booleans and single choice with labels and descriptions; Switch for settings that apply at once.

```tsx
import { Checkbox, Switch, RadioGroup } from "@semi/ui";

<Checkbox checked={auto} onChange={setAuto} label="Tự động in khi rảnh" description="Máy nhận job tiếp theo" />
<Switch checked={notify} onChange={setNotify} label="Thông báo khi in xong" />
<RadioGroup label="Gói dịch vụ" value={plan} onChange={setPlan}
  options={[{ value: "free", label: "Free" }, { value: "pro", label: "Pro", description: "Tối đa 10 máy" }]} />
```

### Tabs (./primitives.html#tabs)

Switching views inside a card or page section (←/→, Home, End); segmented for compact toggles.

```tsx
import { Tabs } from "@semi/ui";

<Tabs value={tab} onChange={setTab} items={[
  { key: "overview", label: "Tổng quan", icon: "gauge", content: <Overview /> },
  { key: "activity", label: "Hoạt động", count: 12, content: <Activity /> },
]} />
<Tabs variant="segmented" value={range} onChange={setRange} items={[{ key: "day", label: "Ngày" }, { key: "week", label: "Tuần" }]} />
```

### Tooltip · Menu · Drawer · Toast (./primitives.html#overlay)

Hints on icon buttons, overflow actions, side sheets for secondary tasks, and transient feedback.

```tsx
import { Tooltip, Menu, Drawer, toast } from "@semi/ui";

<Tooltip content="Làm mới"><Button iconOnly icon="refresh" aria-label="Làm mới" /></Tooltip>
<Menu items={[{ label: "Đổi tên", icon: "edit", onSelect: rename }, { label: "Xoá", icon: "trash", danger: true, onSelect: remove }]} />
<Drawer open={open} onClose={close} title="Bộ lọc">…</Drawer>
toast({ tone: "success", title: "Đã lưu" });   // <ToastHost /> mounted once in the root layout
```

### Alert · Progress (./primitives.html#alert)

Callouts inside a page (status tint + icon + optional action) and determinate / indeterminate progress.

```tsx
import { Alert, Progress, Button } from "@semi/ui";

<Alert tone="warning" title="Sắp hết nhựa" action={<Button size="sm">Đặt thêm</Button>}>Cuộn PLA còn 80 g.</Alert>
<Progress label="Tiến độ in" value={64} showValue />
<Progress label="Đang xử lý" />   {/* no value = indeterminate */}
```

### Table · Avatar · Badge (./primitives.html#table)

Rows compared column by column; cells stay on one line and the table scrolls sideways on phones.

```tsx
import { Table, THead, TBody, TR, TH, TD, Avatar, Badge } from "@semi/ui";

<Table>
  <THead><TR><TH>Mã đơn</TH><TH>Khách hàng</TH><TH align="right">Tổng</TH></TR></THead>
  <TBody>
    {rows.map((r) => (
      <TR key={r.id} onClick={() => open(r)}>
        <TD>{r.code}</TD>
        <TD><Avatar name={r.customer} size="sm" /> {r.customer}</TD>
        <TD numeric>{r.total}</TD>
      </TR>
    ))}
  </TBody>
</Table>
```

### EmptyState (./primitives.html#empty)

An empty list or first run: icon, one line, optional description and the action that adds the first item.

```tsx
import { EmptyState, Button } from "@semi/ui";

<EmptyState icon="printer" title="Chưa có máy in nào" description="Thêm máy in đầu tiên để theo dõi tiến độ."
  action={<Button variant="primary" icon="plus" onClick={add}>Thêm máy in</Button>} />
```

### Locale (SemiLocaleProvider) (./primitives.html#locale)

UI strings of the shared components: Vietnamese by default, English shipped, any key overridable.

```tsx
import { SemiLocaleProvider, en } from "@semi/ui";

<SemiLocaleProvider locale={en}>{children}</SemiLocaleProvider>
<SemiLocaleProvider locale={{ close: "Đóng lại" }}>…</SemiLocaleProvider>   // partial override
```

## Layout Patterns (./patterns.html)

### PageTabsTitle · PageActions (./patterns.html#page-tabs)

2–4 sibling pages under one title; the page's buttons go to the header slot.

```tsx
import { PageTabsTitle, PageActions, Button } from "@semi/ui";

<PageTabsTitle tabs={[{ key: "printers", label: "Máy in" }, { key: "jobs", label: "Job in" }]} value={view} onChange={setView} />
<PageActions><Button variant="primary" iconOnly icon="plus" aria-label="Thêm máy in" /></PageActions>
```

### AppHeader (tool apps) (./patterns.html#app-header)

Top bar of a stand-alone tool / 3D app: logo + title go home, one primary action on the right.

```tsx
import { AppHeader, headerPrimary } from "@semi/ui";

<AppHeader title="Phối màu" productName="3D Noobs" logoIcon="palette" homeHref="/">
  <button className={headerPrimary(ready)} onClick={done}>Xong</button>
</AppHeader>
```

### SidePanel (./patterns.html#side-panel)

The left settings panel of a tool app (320px), collapsing to a thin rail.

```tsx
import { SidePanel, SidePanelToggle } from "@semi/ui";

<div className="h-full flex">
  <SidePanel collapsed={collapsed} onToggleCollapse={() => setCollapsed(!collapsed)}>
    <SidePanelToggle onClick={() => setCollapsed(true)} /> …settings…
  </SidePanel>
  <div className="flex-1 min-w-0">…canvas…</div>
</div>
```

### Markdown (AI text) (./patterns.html#markdown)

Any AI-written text: paragraphs, lists, bold, code and links (ExternalLink); never raw strings.

```tsx
import { Markdown } from "@semi/ui";

<Markdown text={answer} />
```

### Skeletons (./patterns.html#layout-skeletons)

Page-level loading shapes that match the layout being loaded.

```tsx
import { Loading, PageSkeleton, SkeletonGrid } from "@semi/ui";

<Loading><PageSkeleton /></Loading>
<SkeletonGrid count={3} className="grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-3 gap-3" />
```

## AI Chat (./chat.html)

### AIChat (workspace panel) (./chat.html#ai-chat)

Every AI conversation. UI only: the app keeps the messages, streams the answer and owns the provider / model lists.

```tsx
import { AIChat, ChatIntro, ChatSuggestions, ChatSuggestion, ChatModelPicker, type ChatItem } from "@semi/ui";

<div className="relative">   {/* the panel fills the nearest positioned parent; placement="screen" covers the page */}
  <AIChat
    title="Trợ lý AI"
    shown={open}
    onClose={() => setOpen(false)}
    messages={messages}            // ChatItem[]: { id, role, content (Markdown), pending?, error?, failed? }
    busy={streaming}
    onSend={ask}
    onStop={abort}
    onRetry={retry}
    onNewChat={reset}
    toolbar={
      <ChatModelPicker
        providers={providers}      // [{ value, label, icon: <logo /> }]: shown when more than one
        provider={provider} onProviderChange={setProvider}
        models={models} model={model} onModelChange={setModel}
        efforts={efforts} effort={effort} onEffortChange={setEffort}   // only when the model takes one
      />
    }
    empty={
      <>
        <ChatIntro title="Hỏi gì về bản in?">Trợ lý biết máy in và cài đặt của bạn.</ChatIntro>
        <ChatSuggestions label="Gợi ý">
          <ChatSuggestion onClick={() => ask("Vì sao PETG bị kéo sợi?")}>Vì sao PETG bị kéo sợi?</ChatSuggestion>
        </ChatSuggestions>
      </>
    }
  />
</div>
```

### Parts (./chat.html#chat-parts)

Compose a custom chat (e.g. inside a settings tab) from the same parts AIChat uses.

```tsx
import { ChatPanel, ChatView, ChatComposer, UserMessage, AssistantMessage, ChatAnswer, ChatError,
  ChatThinking, ChatCopyButton, Markdown } from "@semi/ui";

<ChatPanel title="Trợ lý AI" onClose={close} onNewChat={messages.length ? reset : undefined}>
  <ChatView busy={busy} empty={!messages.length}
    composer={<ChatComposer value={text} onChange={setText} onSend={ask} busy={busy} onStop={abort} toolbar={picker} />}>
    <UserMessage>Vì sao bản in bị kéo sợi?</UserMessage>
    <AssistantMessage busy={busy} actions={<ChatCopyButton text={answer} />}>
      {answer ? <Markdown text={answer} /> : <ChatThinking />}
    </AssistantMessage>
    <ChatError onRetry={retry}>Không kết nối được tới model.</ChatError>
  </ChatView>
</ChatPanel>
```
